description.en: Design principles and interactive components engineered with purposeful physical animation.
description.zh: 融合物理力学动效与目的性功能主义交互的现代 Web 设计实验系统。

content.en: Fluid Functionalism proposes a design engineering philosophy where visual motion serves immediate functional utility rather than mere ornamentation. It demonstrates spatial momentum, tactile spring resistance, and layout morphing where every frame communicates state change.
content.zh: Fluid Functionalism 提出了将界面动效转化为纯粹功能性指引的设计工程哲学。它拒绝华而不实的装饰性动画，通过弹簧阻尼的势能反馈、惯性位移与连贯的布局形变，让界面的每一次状态迁移都具备直观清晰的物理意义与操作确定感。
